common.serverError: Something went wrong and we couldn't complete that. Check your connection and try again.

layout.disclaimer: Boardwise gives general information about workplace rights in Alberta. It is not legal advice. For advice about your situation, talk to a lawyer.

quickExit.label: Quick exit
quickExit.hint: Leave this site right away and sign out. You can also press Esc twice.

lock.title: Boardwise is locked
lock.idle_one: It locked after {{count}} minute without activity, so no one else can see your issues.
lock.idle_other: It locked after {{count}} minutes without activity, so no one else can see your issues.
lock.manual: It's locked, so no one else can see your issues.
lock.wrongPassword: That password didn't work. Try again.
lock.someoneElse: Not you? Sign in as someone else
lock.warning: Boardwise will lock in 1 minute to keep your issues private.

display.title: Display settings
display.reduceMotionHint: Turns off animations and moving effects.
display.reduceMotionDevice: Your device already asks for less motion, so animations are off.

auth.signInDescription: Sign in to see your saved issues.
auth.signUpDescription: Your account keeps your issues private and saved in one place.
auth.usernameHint: You don't need to use your real name.
auth.invalidCredentials: That username or password isn't right. Check them and try again.
auth.partnerRoleQuestion: What kind of organization are you?
auth.partnerSignUpDescription: For HR boards and law firms. Law firms are shown to workers only after Boardwise has verified them.

roles.hrHint: See anonymous reports and review job descriptions.
roles.lawFirmHint: Offer your expertise to people looking for help.

auth.taglineNote: If yours isn't, we'll help you do something about it.

cases.title: My issues
cases.description: Keep track of each workplace issue in one private place.
cases.empty: You don't have any issues yet.

help.label: Help and resources
help.lawyerText: Browse verified firms. A firm only sees an issue if you choose to share it.
help.privacyText: Only you can see them, unless you share one with a firm. You can stop sharing at any time.

greeting.text: Pick up where you left off, or start a new issue. I'm here when you need me.

entry.description: Record something that happened. You can change it later.
entry.dateFuture: The date can't be in the future.
entry.titleHint: A short summary, for example "Raised the issue with my manager".
entry.titleRequired: Enter a short summary of what happened.
entry.descriptionHint: You don't need to use real names.
entry.deleteMessage: "{{title}}" will be removed from your timeline. This can't be undone.
entry.deleteChatMessage: "{{title}}" will be removed from your timeline. The chat itself is kept and will still be listed as a chat session. This can't be undone.

newCase.title: New issue
newCase.description: Give your issue a short name. You can change it later.
newCase.label: Issue name
newCase.hint: For example, "Comments from my supervisor". You don't need to use real names.
newCase.required: Enter a name for this issue.

case.nextStepsEmpty: Nothing on your checklist yet. Add a step you want to remember.
case.addStepLabel: Add a step to your checklist
case.addStepPlaceholder: Add a step, such as "Save the emails"
case.readOnly: This issue was shared with you, so you can view it but not change it.

chat.intro: Hi, I'm an AI assistant, not a lawyer. Tell me what's happening at work and I'll share general information about your rights in Alberta and possible next steps.
chat.placeholder: Describe what happened. No real names needed.
chat.notice: AI can make mistakes. Not legal advice.
chat.sendFailed: Your message didn't send. It's back in the box so you can try again.
chat.earlierSession: You're viewing an earlier chat from {{date}}.
chat.closeMessage: You won't be able to add to it, but you can still read it from the timeline. Your next message will start a new chat.
chat.closedBar: This chat is closed. You can still read it here or from the timeline.
chat.newChatMessage: Your current chat from {{date}} will be closed, because each issue keeps one chat open at a time. You can still read and download it from the timeline.

dictation.micDenied: We couldn't use your microphone. Check that your browser allows this site to use it.
dictation.busy: Voice typing is busy right now. Try again in a minute, or type your message.
dictation.unavailable: Voice typing isn't available. You can type your message instead.
dictation.offline: Voice typing can't connect right now. Try again later, or type your message.
dictation.tooLong: Voice typing stops after 3 minutes. What you said so far is in the box.
dictation.failed: Voice typing stopped unexpectedly. What you said so far is in the box.

chat.heading: Conversation

starters.label: Ways to start
starters.rights: What are my rights at work?
starters.record: What should I write down and keep?

chat.closedElsewhere: This chat was closed, maybe on another device. Your message is still in the box: send it to start a new chat.

transcript.failed: The transcript couldn't be created. Try again.
transcript.heading: Boardwise chat transcript
transcript.notice: Replies from the AI assistant are general information about workplace rights in Alberta, not legal advice. For advice about your situation, talk to a lawyer.

crisis.title: Are you in immediate danger?
crisis.familyViolenceLine: Alberta Family Violence Info Line (call or text)
crisis.supportLine: 211 Alberta, for local support services (call or text)
crisis.notSent: This message wasn't sent to the AI. Come back to this chat whenever you're ready.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This page doesn't exist or may have moved.

partners.eyebrow: For HR boards and law firms
partners.description: Sign in to your organization or firm account.
partners.hrPoint1: Anonymous reports from people in your organization.
partners.hrPoint2: Trends, shown only once enough people have reported that no one can be singled out.
partners.hrPoint3: Never names or details that could identify someone.
partners.firmPoint1: Cases that a worker has chosen to share with your firm.
partners.firmPoint2: Read-only access, which the worker can take back at any time.
partners.firmPoint3: A profile workers can look at when choosing who to contact.
partners.control: Workers stay in control. Nothing about a case is shared without their permission.

partnerHome.sharedEmpty: No worker has shared a case with your firm yet.

hr.title: Reports dashboard
hr.description: Anonymous report trends from your company and AI checks of job offers. No names, ever.
hr.reportsText: Read reports people chose to send to your board. Who sent them stays hidden.
hr.trendsText: See patterns by team or issue type, only when groups are large enough to keep people anonymous.
hr.jobsText: Check job descriptions for wording that can lead to unsafe or unfair work.

firm.title: Firm dashboard
firm.description: Cases workers have shared with you, and how your firm appears to people looking for help.
firm.statsText: Show the kinds of cases your firm handles.

lawyers.title: Find a lawyer
lawyers.description: Browse firms that help workers. They only see your case if you ask to connect and they accept.

fees.ask: Ask the firm about their fees.

connect.title: Ask to connect
connect.intro: Send this firm a short note. They see only your note until they accept.
connect.noteHint: Describe the situation in general terms. You don't need to include names.
connect.consent: If the firm accepts, they can read this issue: its timeline, next steps and chat. You can stop sharing at any time from the issue page.
connect.sent: Request sent. We'll show the firm's answer on your issue page.
connect.noCases: Create an issue first, then you can ask a firm to look at it.

status.pending: You've already asked this firm about this issue. Waiting for their answer.
status.accepted: This firm accepted your request and can read this issue.

matches.title: Lawyers
matches.none: You haven't asked a firm to look at this issue.

firmRequests.title: Requests from workers
firmRequests.explain: You see only the worker's note. Accepting gives your firm read-only access to their issue, which they can end at any time.
firmRequests.mustBeVerified: Your firm needs to be verified before you can accept requests.

firmProfile.title: Firm profile
firmProfile.description_page: This is what workers see when they browse firms.
firmProfile.name: Firm name
firmProfile.taglineHint: For example: Harassment and wrongful dismissal claims
firmProfile.descriptionHint: What you do, who you help and how you work with clients.
firmProfile.provincesHint: Two-letter codes, separated by commas. For example: AB, BC
firmProfile.feesHint: Fill in what applies. Clear fees help workers decide.
firmProfile.freeConsultation: We offer a free first consultation
firmProfile.slidingScale: We offer a sliding scale based on income
firmProfile.lawSocietyHint: We check this before your firm is listed. It isn't shown to workers. Changing it means we check again.
firmProfile.acceptingHint: Turn this off to hide your firm from the directory without deleting your profile.

status.missingText: Set up your profile so workers can find you.
status.pendingText: We're checking your law society number. Your firm will be listed once it's confirmed.
status.hiddenText: Your firm is verified but hidden, because it isn't accepting new clients or is missing a name or description.
status.listedText: Workers can find your firm and ask to connect.

hrCompany.setupText: Add your company so workers can find it. Boardwise checks every company before workers can pick it or you can see any reports.
hrCompany.name: Company name
hrCompany.verified: Verified. Workers can pick your company and send anonymous reports.
hrCompany.pending: Waiting for Boardwise to verify your company. Reports and job offer checks open once it's verified.
hrCompany.renameWarning: Changing the name sends your company back for verification.

hrDashboard.title: Anonymous reports
hrDashboard.notEnough: Not enough reports to show yet. To protect people's anonymity, nothing appears until there are at least {{k}} reports in the last 12 months.
hrDashboard.byCategoryHint: Types nobody reported are left out.
hrDashboard.privacyNote: Reports carry no names, user IDs or send times. Counts under {{k}} are hidden, and sometimes one more is hidden so a small count can't be worked out from the total.

jobOffers.description: Upload a job offer and Boardwise's AI compares it with your province's employment standards and health and safety rules.
jobOffers.fileHint: PDF, Word (.docx) or text, up to 5 MB.
jobOffers.title: Title (optional)
jobOffers.privacy: The offer is sent to the AI model for this check. Remove details you don't need, like the candidate's name or address.
jobOffers.working: The AI is reading the offer. Short offers take under a minute; long contracts are checked in parts and can take a few minutes.
jobOffers.failed: The AI couldn't finish this check. Try again. If it keeps failing, paste only the main terms (pay, hours, breaks, vacation, termination).
jobOffers.failedNoText: There's no text in this file. It looks like a scanned PDF, where each page is a picture. Open it, copy the text (or use a PDF with selectable text) and choose Paste text instead.
jobOffers.failedUnreadable: This file couldn't be opened. It may be damaged or password-protected. Try exporting it again, or paste the text instead.
jobOffers.deleteText: The file and its check are removed for everyone at your company.
jobOffers.noFindings: The AI didn't find terms that conflict with the reference.
jobOffers.disclaimer: Boardwise's AI can miss things or get them wrong. Check findings against the cited sections, and ask an employment lawyer or your province's employment standards office before relying on them.
jobOffers.partial_one: This offer was checked in {{total}} parts, and the AI didn't answer for part {{parts}}. Findings from that part are missing. Try again to check it.
jobOffers.partial_other: This offer was checked in {{total}} parts, and the AI didn't answer for parts {{parts}}. Findings from those parts are missing. Try again to check them.

workplace.title: Workplace
workplace.description: Link your account to your employer so you can send anonymous reports to its HR team. They only ever see totals, never you.
workplace.notListed: Don't see your company? Its HR team hasn't joined Boardwise yet.
workplace.leaveText: You'll stop being able to send reports to it. Reports you already sent stay in its totals, because they aren't linked to you and can't be found.
workplace.privacy1: Reports hold only the type of incident, the month, and whether it's still happening. No names, no free text.
workplace.privacy2: Reports aren't linked to your account, not even in our database, so nobody can trace them back to you. That also means a sent report can't be taken back.
workplace.privacy3: HR sees totals only, and only when enough people have reported that nobody can be singled out.
workplace.optIn: Let me send anonymous reports to {{company}}
workplace.reportText: Your report adds to your company's totals. It doesn't start an investigation. To get help with your own situation, use My issues.
workplace.monthHint: The month is enough. Pick when it started if it's ongoing.
workplace.limit: You've sent the most reports allowed this month. You can send more next month.
